quests.title: Thin the Pack
quests.description: The east road took the night watch and left only a lantern in the mud. The wolves eat well this winter. Put two of them in the ground and the road may yet be walked.

quests.title: Light for the Watch
quests.description: The wardens burn through torches faster than the dark burns through us. Bring me two, tarred and dry, and I will not ask where you found them.

quests.title: Pale Eyes in the Dusk
quests.description: Past the broken wall something larger hunts, grey as ash and patient as a grave. The hounds that follow it have forgotten fear. Put the master of the pack down and the dusk will be a little less hungry.

quests.title: Marked for the Dark
quests.description: The wolves hate the smell of fire more than they fear the blade. Kill one where they gather and carry a spare torch back to me as proof you lived. Then I will mark you as one of ours.

quests.title: Ash on the Wind
quests.description: Grey things walk the burnt ground beyond the ridge, and the wind carries their ash to my door. Three of them will do. Bring back nothing but the sound of their silence.

quests.title: The Long Road
quests.description: The road runs on past the last lantern, and everything that hunts it wants a wanderer. Cut down two of the great hounds and three of the ash-grey ones, and the road is a little less long.

quests.title: The Howl in the Barrow
quests.description: Something calls from the far barrows at dusk, and the hounds answer it. I will not send a second warden to learn what. End the howl, and bring me the quiet.
